source: registered sparse observed 500ms public-trade bars, January-June 2023

information_unit.boundary: prior completed 30-minute observed-trade high or low
information_unit.event: first rearmed boundary consumption with breach-direction five-second turnover z>=2 against a prior-only 30-day baseline
information_unit.acceptance: five-second close remains outside and signed price progress per normalized aggressive turnover is at or above the January-February median
information_unit.absorption: close returns inside or efficiency is at or below the January-February lower quartile

execution.entry: first observed 500ms bucket open at or after activation
execution.acceptance_stop: one tick inside the frozen boundary
execution.absorption_stop: one tick beyond the observed event extreme
execution.state_exit: first later completed five-second loss of the selected state, then fixed 500ms and first observed bucket
execution.same_bucket: adverse stop first unless observed high/low offsets prove target first

account.funding: actual signed Bybit funding at contemporaneous mark
